result.brief: HWAM 将机器人执行后的本体状态作为显式预测目标，联合生成参考动作与实现状态，并通过策略、前向与逆向动力学三条路径连接动作、身体运动与视觉结果。
result.reason: World Action Model for humanoid robots jointly generating state-action trajectories with forward/inverse dynamics and future visual prediction; main contribution is embodied policy/world modeling, matching secondary application direction.
